# Issue

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Issue`](gmeow-Issue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Issue>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

A tracked issue, ticket, or bug report in a software project — an [`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md) that may carry title, body, labels, and state. The event of its creation/closure is a separate [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Issue`](gmeow-Issue.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
